headword: {社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}

definitions.gloss: social contribution; contributing to society; community service
definitions.explanation: Activities or efforts that benefit society at large, including volunteer work, charitable giving, and corporate social responsibility. A key concept in Japanese corporate and civic culture.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To participate in community service activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: This company puts effort into social contribution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel proud that I can contribute to society through my work.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (society) + ⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧ (contribution). This is a highly valued concept in Japanese society, frequently used in corporate mission statements, job interviews, and discussions about civic responsibility. Japanese companies often have dedicated CSR (⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧) departments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: social contribution activities
- {社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to contribute to society
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧: contribution to the local community
- {社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}{度|ど}: degree of social contribution

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese job interviews, expressing a desire to contribute to society ({社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}がしたい) is a common and valued response when discussing career motivation.
